settings.heading: Made by Hand,
settings.text: We design, print, cut and finish every piece ourselves — toys, party props, and the nursery signs that started it all.

settings.heading: Started in a garage. Still kind of is.
settings.text: Playform started as a way to make one kid's room feel like theirs. It turned into 3D printers, laser cutters and a workbench that never quite gets tidy — and a lot of custom pieces for other people's kids, parties and stores.

settings.title: Designed
settings.text: Original pieces modeled specifically for Playform.

settings.title: Printed + cut
settings.text: 3D printing, resin printing and precision laser cutting.

settings.title: Finished by hand
settings.text: Sanded, assembled, painted and detailed individually.

settings.title: Made for you
settings.text: Custom colors, names, sizing and designs.

settings.title: Handmade, not mass-made
settings.text: Every piece passes through someone's hands before it ships — nothing here comes off a line.

settings.title: Built to actually play with
settings.text: Toys are toys first. If it can't survive a kid's room, we redesign it.

settings.title: Custom is the default
settings.text: Colors, names and sizing are options on almost everything we make, not a special request.
